job_posting.title: Fullstack Developer (C#, .NET, Vuejs) - Lương Upto 40 Triệu/Tháng
job_posting.description:
Mô tả công việc

Ở vị trí Senior Fullstack Developer, bạn sẽ trực tiếp làm chủ các giải pháp từ Frontend đến Backend, tạo ra những cải tiến rõ rệt về hiệu năng, khả năng mở rộng và trải nghiệm người dùng:

  • Thiết kế và phát triển toàn diện từ Frontend, API, Backend .NET đến cơ sở dữ liệu, đồng thời chủ động đề xuất giải pháp kỹ thuật.
  • Xây dựng, chuẩn hóa codebase Frontend với Angular, React hoặc Vue, giúp sản phẩm dễ phát triển, tái sử dụng và mở rộng.
  • Đo lường, tối ưu hiệu năng Client và Backend, cải thiện tốc độ phản hồi, trải nghiệm người dùng và khả năng chịu tải của hệ thống.
  • Giải quyết các bài toán chuyên sâu về Transaction, Caching, Concurrency, Messaging và hệ thống có lượng truy cập lớn.
  • Tham gia định hình kiến trúc, thực hiện Design Review, Code Review và Testing, góp phần xây dựng sản phẩm ổn định, dễ bảo trì.
  • Phối hợp cùng Product Manager, BA và DevOps để chuyển hóa nhu cầu kinh doanh thành giải pháp công nghệ hiệu quả.
  • Chia sẻ chuyên môn, mentoring thành viên và phát triển năng lực theo định hướng Technical Leadership.

Yêu cầu ứng viên

Bạn sẽ phù hợp nếu

  • Có từ 3-4 năm kinh nghiệm phát triển ứng dụng Web với C#, .NET/.NET Core và hiểu cách tổ chức hệ thống theo Clean Architecture.
  • Có kinh nghiệm phát triển Frontend với JavaScript/TypeScript và ít nhất một framework Angular, React hoặc Vue; có khả năng xây dựng, chuẩn hóa codebase.
  • Đã trực tiếp tối ưu hiệu năng Backend và Client, mang lại cải thiện thực tế về tốc độ phản hồi, trải nghiệm người dùng hoặc khả năng chịu tải.
  • Nắm vững OOP, SOLID, Design Pattern; có tư duy viết mã dễ đọc, dễ kiểm thử và bảo trì.
  • Thành thạo SQL Server/MySQL, có kinh nghiệm thiết kế dữ liệu và tối ưu truy vấn.
  • Có khả năng phân tích vấn đề, phối hợp đội nhóm và chủ động đề xuất giải pháp kỹ thuật.

Lợi thế nếu bạn có

  • Kinh nghiệm với Redis, RabbitMQ, Microservices, Docker hoặc CI/CD.
  • Đã sử dụng các công cụ đo lường hiệu năng Frontend như Lighthouse, Chrome DevTools hoặc Web Vitals.
  • Có kinh nghiệm với hệ thống quy mô lớn, Unit Test, Code Review hoặc mentoring thành viên.

Quyền lợi được hưởng

Tiên phong công nghệ, uy tín

  • Vị thế: Doanh nghiệp CNTT tại khu vực Châu Á - Đại Dương tiên phong giải pháp SaaS, AIaaS và AaaS.
  • Tăng trưởng bền vững: Ghi nhận mức lợi nhuận tăng >20%/năm, doanh thu tăng 15%/năm.
  • Sứ mệnh quốc gia: Đồng hành cùng 500.000 tổ chức và 3.5 triệu khách hàng cá nhân trong hành trình Chuyển đổi số quốc gia.
  • Ghi nhận danh giá: Sở hữu hơn 100 giải thưởng công nghệ uy tín trong và ngoài nước.

Nâng tầm phát triển sự nghiệp

  • Thu nhập: Mức lương cạnh tranh vượt trội lên tới 35 triệu/tháng
  • Thưởng Performance dựa trên kết quả sản phẩm.
  • Thưởng nhân viên xuất sắc tháng/6 tháng/Vinh danh "Gấu vàng MISA" hàng năm
  • Lộ trình thăng tiến: Cơ hội phát triển lên các vị trí quản lý chiến lược như Techlead, Engineering Manager, Product Manager
  • Tham gia chiến lược: Trực tiếp xây dựng Product Roadmap và quyết định các tính năng cốt lõi cho sản phẩm AMIS Kế toán.
  • Đột phá công nghệ: Trực tiếp tham gia các dự án ứng dụng Agentic AI vào giải quyết nghiệp vụ tài chính/kế toán và thiết kế giải pháp tự động hóa.
  • Đào tạo lãnh đạo: Tham gia chương trình đào tạo cán bộ kế cận, chương trình Huấn luyện “Hổ Tướng MISA” nhằm bồi dưỡng thế hệ quản lý tài năng

Môi trường thân thiện, chia sẻ, đồng hành

  • Chế độ phúc lợi: Chăm sóc sức khỏe tại Medlatec, teambuilding thường niên và các kỳ nghỉ lễ hấp dẫn.
  • Văn hóa kết nối: Làm việc cùng những tài năng cùng chí hướng trong môi trường sáng tạo, năng động và hạnh phúc.
  • Công cụ hiện đại:
    • Trang bị máy tính cấu hình cao cùng hệ sinh thái công nghệ chuyên nghiệp (AMIS, Jira, Power BI, AI Marketing...)
    • Được cấp tài khoản sử dụng các công cụ AI (OneAI) hiện đại nhất để tối ưu hóa hiệu suất công việc

job_posting.title: Senior Tech Lead - Salary Up To $3,000 USD
job_posting.description:
Mô tả công việc

We are seeking an experienced Head of Technology to take ownership of our backend platform and AI-driven product delivery. This is a senior, genuinely hands-on leadership role: expect to split your time roughly evenly between hands-on technical work - architecture, coding, code review, and building AI-powered features yourself - and people and delivery leadership.

  • Spend approximately half your working time hands-on in the codebase — architecture, coding, and code review — with particular focus on priority and AI-driven features.
  • Hold final accountability for technical decisions, architecture direction and code quality across the Vietnam development team. Own architecture across the backend, and set direction for the frontend at an architectural level.
  • Set and enforce coding standards, branching strategy, technical processes and review practices — across backend and frontend, working through and alongside the Tech Lead. Review the frontend team's code and hold the quality line there, even though you are not writing most of it.
  • Own security practice: authentication and authorisation, secrets handling, dependency and supply-chain risk, and data protection appropriate to our clients' obligations.
  • Evaluate new technologies, frameworks and tools, and decide what the team adopts.
  • Resolve technical escalations — including stepping in to code a fix personally when it's the fastest path to resolution.
  • Own the cloud infrastructure, CI/CD, deployment and observability.
  • Own production. You are the person who gets the backend working again when it breaks.
  • Own technical risk. Identify technical debt, security risk or delivery risk early, quantify it, and act on it — not just report it, but put it in front of the CEO with an option and a recommendation.

Delivery & Operations Oversight

  • Own delivery performance across all active projects: timelines, quality, resourcing and client-facing technical commitments.
  • Manage workload and resourcing across the team, including prioritisation when capacity is under pressure.
  • Run the operational rhythm of the team: standups, sprint planning, reporting cadence.
  • Identify and remove delivery bottlenecks before they become client-facing problems.
  • Report delivery status, risks and resourcing needs directly to the CEO, with a clear view and a recommendation, not just a status update.

Team Leadership & Development

  • Hold direct leadership accountability for the full Vietnam technical team: developers, Business Analysis and QA/Testing.
  • Manage the Development team directly, including performance, development and workload.
  • Build the capability of the wider team, including BA and QA: mentoring, career development, and identifying who is ready for more responsibility.
  • Own hiring input and onboarding for engineering roles in Vietnam.
  • Handle performance issues directly and early. Escalate to the CEO only when needed, with the issue already worked through.

AI Adoption & Implementation

  • Own the practical rollout of AI tools and AI-assisted workflows across the engineering team, from code generation through to testing and documentation.
  • Identify where AI can reduce delivery time or cost on client work, and put it into production, not just pilot it.
  • Set the expectation and baseline that AI-assisted tools are part of how the team works day to day, not an optional extra.
  • Track and report the impact of AI adoption on delivery speed, cost and quality.
  • Keep the team current on relevant AI development tools and bring forward what's worth adopting.

Yêu cầu ứng viên

  • 8+ years of experience in backend engineering, with proven experience as a Tech Lead / Engineering Lead - and still hands-on in the codebase today.
  • Strong expertise in backend system design, APIs, and cloud infrastructure.
  • Hands-on experience delivering AI / LLM-powered products in production environments.
  • Proven ability to lead teams, manage delivery, and balance technical trade-offs with business needs.
  • Excellent communication skills in English with the ability to engage technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Strong sense of ownership, accountability, and operational discipline.
  • Hard-working and hands-on: willing to jump in and help wherever the team needs it, not just delegate and report.
  • Comfortable operating in a fast-paced, sometimes ambiguous, client-facing environment where priorities can shift quickly.

Quyền lợi được hưởng

  • Competitive salary - up to $3,000 USD per month depending on experience
  • Social insurance on full salary per government legislation
  • Great leave options
    • 12 days annual leave and 5 days of paid sick leave during Year 1
    • Increasing to 15 days annual leave in Year 2
  • 13th month salary
  • Birthday leave after probation
  • Continuous learning and development
  • Reward and recognition - company-sponsored trips and events
  • Private health insurance and annual health check-up
  • State-of-the-art equipment: laptop, monitor, and headset
  • Support from, and collaboration with, talented and friendly colleagues
  • An international work environment with highly skilled colleagues to learn from, both locally and globally, where you can grow your IT career and English skills
  • Working hours: 8:30 a.m. - 5:30 p.m. (1-hour lunch break), Monday to Friday

job_posting.title: Automotive Software Engineer (C++, AUTOSAR, Android) - Sign-On Bonus Onboard 3 Tháng Tới
job_posting.description:
Mô tả công việc

  • Analyze software requirements and participate in architecture, design and development of automotive embedded software.
  • Develop and maintain embedded software using C/C++ on Linux, QNX, Android or AUTOSAR-based platforms.
  • Develop and integrate system-level components such as middleware, OS services, drivers, BSP/bootloader-related modules and hardware interfaces.
  • Develop automotive HMI/GUI applications using C++/Qt/QML and support graphics-related features when required.
  • Participate in Embedded Android development, including HAL, system services and platform integration.
  • Develop and integrate AUTOSAR or non-AUTOSAR software components and automotive communication functions.
  • Perform software integration, unit testing, debugging, performance analysis and issue resolution on target hardware.
  • Work with global teams, architects and other stakeholders to clarify requirements and ensure software quality.
  • Participate in code review, CI/CD and continuous improvement activities.

Yêu cầu ứng viên

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Electronics, Mechatronics or related fields.
  • 2+ years of experience in embedded software development.
  • Strong programming skills in C/C++, with good knowledge of OOP, debugging and software design.
  • Hands-on experience in one or more of the following areas: Embedded Linux, QNX, AUTOSAR, Embedded Android, Qt/QML.
  • Good understanding of embedded systems, microcontrollers, SoC architecture and hardware/software integration.
  • Experience with one or more of the following is preferred: BSP/bootloader, device drivers, Android HAL/Services, AUTOSAR configuration, HMI/GUI development.
  • Knowledge of automotive communication protocols such as CAN, LIN, UDS is an advantage.
  • Familiarity with Git, unit testing and CI/CD development workflows.
  • Knowledge of automotive standards such as ISO 26262, MISRA or ASPICE is an advantage.
  • Good English communication, analytical thinking and problem-solving skills.

Quyền lợi được hưởng

  • Good salary (includes base salary, additional salary, housing allowance, meal allowance, etc.)
  • 13th month salary + Incentive/performance bonus
  • Salary review twice a year
  • Lunch monthly support
  • Mon–Fri & alternative Saturday working schedule with 44 hours/week.
  • 12 annual leave days plus 1 birthday leave
  • Health care insurance
  • Training & career development program
  • Oversea working opportunities
  • Working in international environment with experts around the world
  • Opportunities for career advancement to Team Leader, Group Leader, and Manager positions
  • Monthly budget for team activities, etc.

job_posting.title: SAP Fiori Developer
job_posting.description:
Mô tả công việc

Responsibilities

  • Analyze business requirements and design SAP Fiori/UI solutions for SAP S/4HANA projects.
  • Develop, customize, and maintain SAP Fiori and SAPUI5 applications.
  • Develop and consume OData Services for SAP applications.
  • Extend standard SAP Fiori applications and develop custom Fiori applications based on business requirements.
  • Configure and maintain SAP Fiori Launchpad, catalogs, spaces, pages, groups, and roles.
  • Collaborate with Functional Consultants (FI, CO, MM, SD, PP, PS, etc.) and ABAP developers to deliver end-to-end SAP solutions.
  • Perform application testing, troubleshooting, performance optimization, and production support.
  • Prepare technical documentation and support UAT, go-live, and hypercare activities.
  • Participate in SAP S/4HANA implementation, rollout, migration, and enhancement projects.
  • Follow SAP best practices, Clean Core principles, and SAP Fiori Design Guidelines.

     

Yêu cầu ứng viên

Minimum 4+ years of experience in SAP Fiori/UI5 development.
Strong experience with:
SAPUI5
SAP Fiori
SAP Gateway
OData Services (V2/V4)
Experience with SAP Business Application Studio (BAS) or SAP Web IDE.
Experience developing and extending SAP Fiori applications.
Basic knowledge of SAP ABAP and backend integration.
Experience with SAP Fiori Launchpad configuration and authorization concepts.
Experience working in SAP S/4HANA environments.
Fluent English communication skills (both written and spoken).
Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills.
Available to work from 14:00 to 23:00 (Vietnam Time) or other schedules depending on project requirements.
Willing to travel or work onsite in Korea or other countries when required.

Nice to Have

Experience with SAP Fiori Elements.
Experience with CDS Views and RAP (RESTful ABAP Programming Model).
Knowledge of SAP BTP (Business Technology Platform).
Experience with SAP Build Apps, SAP Build Work Zone, or SAP Build Process Automation.
Experience with SAP Mobile Services.
Experience with SAP S/4HANA Cloud (Public or Private Edition).
Experience in AMS/Support projects and SLA-based service delivery.
Familiarity with SAP Clean Core and Fit-to-Standard methodologies.
SAP Fiori, SAPUI5, or SAP BTP certification.
Experience working in multinational or offshore project environments.

Quyền lợi được hưởng

  • Attractive salary and bonus will be discussed after CV screening and interview.
  • TOPIK allowance.
  • Annual performance review and salary adjustment based on work results.
  • Health care benefits: Premium health insurance and annual health check-up.
  • Young, dynamic, and professional working environment.
  • Clear career development path in cloud and infrastructure engineering.
  • Training programs including English, Korean, technical, and soft skills courses.
  • Opportunities to learn new cloud technologies, automation, and security practices from LG CNS.
  • Holiday gifts (April 30th – May 1st, September 2nd, Tet, etc.).
  • Company-sponsored activities: sports clubs, team building, happy hours, birthdays, and family events.

job_posting.title: ServiceNow ITSM Developer
job_posting.description:
Mô tả công việc

We are looking for a talented ServiceNow ITSM Developer to join a large-scale enterprise IT service management project for a leading airline customer in Korea.

Key Responsibilities

  • Develop and maintain ITSM functionalities on the ServiceNow platform, including:
    • Incident Management
    • Service Request Management
    • Change Management
    • Problem Management
  • Develop solutions using:
    • Client Scripts
    • Business Rules
    • Script Includes
    • Glide API
  • Design and automate business processes using Flow Designer and Workflow.
  • Customize and enhance Service Portal interfaces.
  • Integrate ServiceNow with external systems using IntegrationHub and APIs.
  • Participate in CMDB and CSDM implementation and maintenance.
  • Troubleshoot production issues and provide system enhancements.
  • Collaborate with PMs, BAs, and stakeholders to analyze requirements and implement solutions.

 

Yêu cầu ứng viên

 

  • 3-5 years of hands-on experience with ServiceNow development or implementation.
  • Strong experience in:
    • Client/Server-side scripting
    • Glide API development
    • Business Rules and Script Includes
  • Practical experience with:
    • CSDM
    • CMDB
    • IntegrationHub
    • Flow Designer / Workflow
  • Good understanding of ITSM processes and ITIL best practices.
  • Experience working in enterprise-scale ServiceNow environments.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Good communication and teamwork abilities.

Preferred Qualifications

  • One or more ServiceNow certifications:
    • CSA (Certified System Administrator)
    • CAD (Certified Application Developer)
    • CIS-ITSM (Certified Implementation Specialist - ITSM)
  • Experience in CMDB/CSDM implementation or data integration.
  • Experience supporting enterprise IT operation processes.
  • English communication skills.

Benefits

  • Opportunity to work on international enterprise projects.
  • Professional and collaborative working environment.
  • Continuous learning and certification support for ServiceNow technologies.
  • Competitive salary and performance-based bonus.
  • Comprehensive healthcare and employee benefits package.

Quyền lợi được hưởng

 

  • Attractive salary and bonus will be discussed after going through CV & Interview
  • Topik allowance
  • Review capacity annually and adjust salary increases according to work performance.
  • Health care: Premium health insurance, Annual health check-up
  • Young working environment
  • Good career development opportunities with interesting and challenging projects.
  • English, Korean, technical, soft skills training courses.
  • Opportunity to learn special courses from LG CNS, new technology and security.
  • Gifts on holidays (April 30th - May 1st, September 2nd, Tet, etc.)
  • Outdoor activities with company support: sports clubs, team building, happy hour parties, birthdays, travel, employee and family events, etc.
  • Working hours: 8 hours from Monday - Friday (8 hours/day)
